artifacts.summary: Six-phase, strictly linear plan absorbing the paper's z/d/r rename and full drift wave into specs/paper-definitions-of-record.md, then re-labelling 32 in-tree citation sites and correcting the invalidated Hoelder/prop:archimedean prose.

memory_candidates.content: Paper-anchor drift in this repo is guarded by TWO gates with different jobs, and conflating them is the main source of scope error. scripts/check-module-invariants.sh C15 checks anchor NAMES against specs/paper-definitions-of-record.md and never touches the .tex, so a paper rename stays invisible to C15 for exactly as long as the stale manifest row survives -- C15 can be fully green while the record asserts anchors the paper no longer defines. scripts/check-paper-definitions.sh checks anchor HASHES against the live paper and is the only honest drift detector; its exit 0 (quiet case-(a) pass) is the real acceptance gate for any re-pin task. Two ordering rules follow: (1) record first, docstrings second -- re-labelling citation sites before the new manifest rows exist turns C15 red mid-implementation; (2) absorb a drift wave as one unit and force full anchor validation by re-running the checker with the OLD FILE_CHECKSUM still in place (expect a case-(b) notice pass) before re-pinning the sentinels. Also: C15 is cheap to reproduce standalone in ~1s by comm-ing the two sentinel-delimited record blocks against a grep sweep, whereas the full check-module-invariants.sh run exceeds 15 minutes -- background it.
